Pig Rules
Roll the dice to see who goes first. Highest role of the die is the first player.
When a Pig player takes their turn, they can roll the die as many times as they want. Scoring is simple – whatever the number of dots show up on the die, that's your points for the roll. You keep rolling and accumulating the points. If you roll a 3, then a 5, then a 2, and then a 6 your points
pig.ending:
passed along to the next Pig player.
Here's where the jeopardy or chance common with many dice games comes into play. At any point during their turn, a Pig player can choose to stop rolling the die (called "holding") and add their current points to their overall score.
As mentioned already, the first player to reach 100 or more points is the winner.
When a player reaches a total of 100 or more points, the game ends and that player is the winner.

This Buddhist temple was built in 1601 CE, and its iconic status in the region stems from a local legend about its construction. The most striking structure on its grounds today is the octagonal seven-story Phuoc Duyen Pagoda. Measuring 21 meters in height, it is the tallest structure of its kind in Vietnam and is considered the unofficial symbol of Hue, the imperial capital of the last Vietnamese dynasty.
